text: Because information in decentralized systems is continuously outdated by a changing environment, decentralized governance must be autonomous and automated, able to evolve, mutate, and create new information precedent, in the way mitosis replaces worn out cells.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Preface to (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782191
abstract: Like mitosis, this decentralized governance process has to be autonomous and automated in the system. Decentralized governance has to be able to evolve and mutate and create new information precedent for the continuous efficient operation of the system.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: decentralized systems whose information changes continuously
